title: Senior Quality Assurance and Automation Engineer
description:
Location: Trivandrum
 Work Mode: Hybrid 3 Days Work from Office 
 We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to build and maintain scalable automation solutions for enterprise banking applications. 
 Key Responsibilities: Design, develop and maintain automation frameworks for UI, API, backend and integration testing . Automate functional, regression, integration and end-to-end test scenarios. Perform API, database and event-driven testing and troubleshoot defects. Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing. 
 Required Skills: Experience in QA Automation / SDET / Quality Engineering . Strong hands-on experience with Selenium, Playwright or Cypress . Experience in API testing/automation using REST Assured, Postman or similar tools. Good knowledge of SQL and database validation . Experience with Jenkins, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions . Strong programming/scripting skills in Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python or C# . Experience in banking, financial services or fintech is preferred. 
 Good to Have: 
Kafka/event-driven testing, performance testing, Docker/Kubernetes and cloud technologies. 
 Interested candidates can apply with their updated resume.

Key Skills: Automation Testing,Quality Assurance,Azure DevOps,Cypress,API Testing,Playwright,Kafka,Selenium
